eval_spec.abstention_semantics: Abstain when the role, error code, or applicable clause is missing or contradictory; identify the unresolved evidence and take no action.
adjudication_requirements: Review any deterministic and holistic assessment disagreement.

deterministic_checks.description: Match ticket facts to the applicable clauses and recompute diagnosis, evidence, allowed resolution, and route.
Reject unsupported diagnoses, missing evidence, permission changes, retries, contacts, or live fixes.

eval_spec.error_semantics: Treat malformed ticket or policy structures as an error; do not infer a role or permission.

holistic_rubric.description: The exception analysis is bounded, evidence-complete, policy-grounded, and useful to a human reviewer without exercising authority.

eval_spec.success_semantics: Every required deterministic check passes and the required holistic criterion is accepted.
